security.reason: The feature is the authorization hardening itself. Tenant scope is derived per request on the server from the JWT, never from the body or query; membership is re-verified; reads and writes run through scoped filters, including audit; the refresh token validates its clinic. The e2e suite proves cross-tenant refusals. No secret or dependency was added.
